ex.cn: 这条路到此为止。

ex.cn: 他在贫穷中度过余生。

ex.cn: 结果所有的活儿都是我一个人干了。

ex.cn: 如果你继续这样，早晚得进监狱。

ex.cn: 我们孩子的健康正受到废气损害。

ex.cn: 在科学探索领域的进步

senses.def: to try to do sth

ex.cn: 他的画描绘出法国的神韵。

ex.cn: 在这种情况下，时间是至关重要的。

senses.chn: 完全必要的；必不可少的；极其重要的

ex.cn: 诸如燃气、水、电等基本公共事业

ex.cn: 博物馆正在进行大修，在此期间暂停开放。

ex.cn: 对于这个工作，经验是非常重要的。

ex.cn: 我与萨拉的根本区别在于我们对金钱的态度。

ex.cn: 这个城镇的主要特色被这条新公路毁了。

ex.cn: 我只来得及装上最基本的必需品。

ex.cn: 解决这个问题有三种本质上完全不同的方法。

ex.cn: 这种模式在所有情况下基本相同。

ex.cn: 新条约设立了自由贸易区。

ex.cn: 这所学校与当地社区建立了良好的关系。

ex.cn: 那时她作为明星的地位已经确立。

ex.cn: 他刚建立起自己的公司，但要站稳脚跟还得花上一段时间。

ex.cn: 正是这场运动确立了这家报纸的声誉。

ex.cn: 警方仍在努力确定事故的原因。

ex.cn: 他们已经证实他是摔伤的。

ex.en: We need to establish where she was at the time of the shooting.
ex.cn: 我们需要查实枪击发生时她在何处。

ex.cn: 这颗卫星估计要耗资 4 亿英镑。

ex.cn: 警方估计聚集的人有 3 万。

senses.def: that can be divided exactly by two

ex.en: 4, 6, 8, 10 are all even numbers.

senses.def: equally spaced and the same size
senses.chn: 匀称的；均匀的；同样大小的

ex.en: even features/teeth
ex.cn: 匀称的面容；整齐的牙齿

senses.def: calm; not changing or becoming upset
senses.chn: 镇静的；稳重的；平和的，温和的

ex.en: She has a very even temperament.
ex.cn: 她的性情非常平和。

ex.en: He spoke in a steady, even voice.
ex.cn: 当时他说话的声音平稳而镇静。

senses.def: to no longer owe sb money or a favour
to cause sb the same amount of trouble or harm as they have caused you
senses.chn: （向某人）报复；（跟某人）算账，扯平

ex.en: I'll get even with you for this, just you wait.
ex.cn: 这事我会找你算账的，等着瞧吧。

senses.def: to complete a piece of business, etc. without either losing money or making a profit

ex.en: The company just about broke even last year.
ex.cn: 这家公司去年接近收支平衡。

senses.def: to be equally likely to do or not do sth
senses.chn: （做某事）有一半的机会；正反各半的可能性

ex.en: She has more than an even chance of winning tomorrow.
ex.cn: 她明天多半会赢。

senses.def: living, working or happening in a calm way, with no sudden changes, especially after a difficult time
senses.chn: （生活、工作等经历困难后）平稳下来，顺顺当当

senses.def: no particular person, team, etc. is doing better than the others in a competition, an argument, etc.
to harm or punish sb who has harmed or cheated you in the past
to become level or steady, usually after varying a lot
senses.chn: （在多变之后）变平坦，稳定下来

ex.en: House prices keep rising and falling but they should eventually even out.
ex.cn: 房价一直时涨时落，但最终应该会趋于平稳。

senses.def: to spread things equally over a period of time or among a number of people

ex.en: He tried to even out the distribution of work among his employees.
ex.cn: 他尽量把工作平均分配给雇员。

senses.def: to make a situation or a competition more equal
just at the same time as sb does sth or as sth else happens

ex.en: Even as he shouted the warning the car skidded.
ex.cn: 他正在高喊注意时，汽车就打滑了。

senses.def: completely fair, especially when dealing with different groups of people
senses.chn: 不偏不倚的；公正的；公平的

senses.def: the part of the day between the afternoon and the time you go to bed

ex.en: I'll see you tomorrow evening.
ex.cn: 我明天晚上来看你。

ex.en: Come over on Thursday evening.
ex.cn: 星期四晚上过来。

ex.en: What do you usually do in the evening?
ex.cn: 你晚上通常干什么？

ex.en: She's going to her sister's for the evening.
ex.cn: 她打算晚上到姐姐家去。

ex.en: the long winter evenings
ex.cn: 冬季漫长的夜晚

ex.en: the evening performance
ex.cn: 晚上的演出

senses.def: an event of a particular type happening in the evening

ex.en: a musical evening at school (= when music is performed)
ex.cn: 学校的音乐晚会

senses.def: recently
senses.chn: 那天，那天早上，那天晚上，那个星期（用于指说话前不久的日子）

ex.en: I saw Jack the other day.
ex.cn: 我前几天看到杰克了。

senses.def: a course of study for adults in the evening

ex.en: an evening class in car maintenance
ex.cn: 夜校的汽车维修课程

ex.en: to go to/attend evening classes
ex.cn: 上夜校

senses.def: elegant clothes worn for formal occasions in the evening

ex.en: Everyone was in evening dress.
ex.cn: 人人都身着晚礼服。

senses.def: a woman's long formal dress
a plant with yellow flowers that open in the evening, sometimes used as a medicine
senses.chn: 月见草（晚间开黄花，有时作药用）

senses.def: in a smooth, regular or equal way
senses.chn: 平滑地；有规律地；均匀地；相等地

ex.en: Make sure the paint covers the surface evenly.
ex.cn: 要确保油漆均匀地涂在表面上。

ex.en: She was fast asleep, breathing evenly.
ex.cn: 她睡熟了，呼吸很平稳。

ex.en: evenly spaced at four cm apart
ex.cn: 以四厘米的间隔均匀分布

senses.def: with equal amounts for each person or in each place

ex.en: evenly distributed/divided
ex.cn: 平均分配／分开

ex.en: Incidence of the disease is fairly evenly spread across Europe.
ex.cn: 这种疾病的发生率在欧洲各地相当平均。

ex.en: The two teams are very evenly matched (= are equally likely to win).
ex.cn: 这两个队势均力敌。

senses.def: calmly; without showing any emotion

ex.en: 'I warned you not to phone me,' he said evenly.
ex.cn: “我告诫过你不要给我打电话。” 他平静地说。

senses.def: odds that give an equal chance of winning or losing and that mean a person has the chance of winning the same amount of money that he or she has bet
senses.chn: 同额赌注；均等的输赢机会

senses.def: to become level or steady, usually after varying a lot
senses.chn: （在多变之后）变平坦，稳定下来

ex.en: House prices keep rising and falling but they should eventually even out.
ex.cn: 房价一直时涨时落，但最终应该会趋于平稳。

senses.def: despite that

ex.en: There are a lot of spelling mistakes; even so, it's quite a good essay.
ex.cn: 尽管有许多拼写错误，它仍不失为一篇佳作。

senses.def: the service of evening prayer in the Anglican Church
a thing that happens, especially sth important
senses.chn: 发生的事情；（尤指）重要事情，大事

ex.en: The election was the main event of 2008.
ex.cn: 那次选举是 2008 年的重大事件。

ex.en: In the light of later events the decision was proved right.
ex.cn: 从后来发生的事看，这一决定证明是正确的。

ex.en: The decisions we take now may influence the course of events (= the way things happen) in the future.
ex.cn: 我们现在作出的决定可能会对未来事情的发展产生影响。

ex.en: Everyone was frightened by the strange sequence of events.
ex.cn: 人人都因接二连三发生的怪事感到惊恐。

ex.en: In the normal course of events (= if things had happened as expected) she would have gone with him.
ex.cn: 要是事情发展顺利的话，她已同他一块儿走了。

senses.def: a planned public or social occasion

ex.en: a fund-raising event
ex.cn: 筹款活动

ex.en: the social event of the year
ex.cn: 本年度最重要的社交活动

senses.def: one of the races or competitions in a sports programme

ex.en: The 800 metres is the fourth event of the afternoon.
ex.cn: 800 米赛是下午的第四项比赛。

senses.def: after sth has happened

ex.en: Anyone can be wise after the event.
ex.cn: 事后聪明谁都会。

senses.def: used to emphasize or show that sth is true or will happen in spite of other circumstances

ex.en: I think she'll agree to do it but in any event, all she can say is 'no'.
ex.cn: 我想她会同意做的，但无论怎样，她只能说 “不”。

senses.def: when the situation actually happened

ex.en: I got very nervous about the exam, but in the event, I needn't have worried; it was really easy.
ex.cn: 我对考试提心吊胆，但其实我本不必担心，这次考试的确很容易。

senses.def: if sth happens

ex.en: In the event of an accident, call this number.
ex.cn: 万一发生事故就拨这个号码。

ex.en: Sheila will inherit everything in the event of his death.
ex.cn: 他一旦故去，所有财产都由希拉继承。

senses.def: if that happens
senses.chn: 如果是那样的话；如果那种事情发生

ex.en: In that event, we will have to reconsider our offer.
ex.cn: 如果是那样的话，我们就得重新考虑我们的建议。

senses.def: the birth of a baby
to understand sth, or realize what you should have done, only after sth has happened
not easily made angry or upset
full of things that happen, especially exciting, important or dangerous things
senses.chn: 充满大事的；多事故的；多变故的

ex.en: an eventful day/life/journey
ex.cn: 不平凡的一天；多姿多彩的一生／旅程

senses.def: to harm or punish sb who has harmed or cheated you in the past
evening
the sport of taking part in competitions riding horses. These are often held over three days and include riding across country, jumping and dressage.
senses.chn: 马术三项赛，马术三日赛（包括越野赛、障碍赛和盛装舞步）

senses.def: happening at the end of a period of time or of a process

ex.en: the eventual winner of the tournament
ex.cn: 锦标赛的最终胜利者

ex.en: It is impossible to predict what the eventual outcome will be.
ex.cn: 无法预测最终结果会怎么样。

ex.en: The village school may face eventual closure.
ex.cn: 这所乡村学校可能面临最后被关闭。

senses.def: something that may possibly happen, especially sth unpleasant
senses.chn: （尤指令人不快的）可能发生的事情，可能出现的结果

ex.en: We were prepared for every eventuality.
ex.cn: 我们已做好准备应付任何可能出现的情况。

ex.en: The money had been saved for just such an eventuality.
ex.cn: 钱积攒下来就是为应付这样的意外。

senses.def: at the end of a period of time or a series of events

ex.en: Our flight eventually left five hours late.
ex.cn: 我们的班机最终晚了五个小时起飞。

ex.en: I'll get round to mending it eventually.
ex.cn: 我最后会抽出时间来修理它的。

ex.en: She hopes to get a job on the local newspaper and eventually work for 'The Times'.
ex.cn: 她希望先在当地报社找一份工作，而最终到《泰晤士报》工作。

senses.def: to happen as a result of sth
used in negative sentences and questions, or sentences with if to mean 'at any time'
senses.chn: （用于否定句和疑问句，或与 if 连用的句子）在任何时候，从来

ex.en: Nothing ever happens here.
ex.cn: 这儿从未发生过任何事。

ex.en: Don't you ever get tired?
ex.cn: 难道你从来不累吗？

ex.en: If you're ever in Miami, come and see us.
ex.cn: 你要是什么时候到了迈阿密，就来看看我们吧。

ex.en: 'Have you ever thought of changing your job?' 'No, never/No I haven't.'
ex.cn: “你想过换一下工作吗？” “没有，从未想过。”

ex.en: 'Have you ever been to Rome?' 'Yes, I have, actually. Not long ago.'
ex.cn: “你去过罗马吗？” “是的，我确实去过，就在不久前。”

ex.en: She hardly ever (= almost never) goes out.
ex.cn: 她几乎从不出门。

senses.def: used for emphasis when you are comparing things
senses.chn: （进行比较时用以加强语气）以往任何时候，曾经

ex.en: It was raining harder than ever.
ex.cn: 当时下着前所未有的大雨。

ex.en: It's my best ever score.
ex.cn: 这是我得到过的最好分数。

senses.def: all the time or every time; always

ex.en: Paul, ever the optimist, agreed to try again.
ex.cn: 保罗这个永远的乐观主义者答应再试一次。

ex.en: She married the prince and they lived happily ever after.
ex.cn: 她与王子成了婚，从此过着幸福的生活。

ex.en: He said he would love her for ever (and ever).
ex.cn: 他说会永远爱她。

ex.en: Their debts grew ever larger (= kept increasing).
ex.cn: 他们的债务不断增加。

ex.en: the ever-growing problem
ex.cn: 日趋严重的问题

ex.en: an ever-present danger
ex.cn: 始终存在的危险

senses.def: used after when, why, etc. to show that you are surprised or shocked
senses.chn: （用于 when、why 等之后表示惊讶）究竟，到底

ex.en: Why ever did you agree?
ex.cn: 你究竟为什么要同意？

senses.def: used to emphasize that sb does the same thing very often, usually in an annoying way
senses.chn: 某人只会／就知道做某事

ex.en: All he ever does is grumble about things.
ex.cn: 他只会抱怨。

senses.def: used to show that you are surprised or shocked

ex.en: Did you ever hear anything like it?
ex.cn: 你听到过这种事吗？

senses.def: continuously since the time mentioned

ex.en: He's had a car ever since he was 18.
ex.cn: 他从 18 岁起就有汽车了。

ex.en: I was bitten by a dog once and I've been afraid of them ever since.
ex.cn: 我曾被狗咬过，自那以后就一直害怕狗。

senses.def: very; really

ex.en: He looks ever so smart.
ex.cn: 他样子很帅。

ex.en: She's ever such a nice woman.
ex.cn: 她是个非常好的女人。

ex.en: It's ever so easy.
ex.cn: 这非常容易。

senses.def: used to emphasize that sth is certainly true
senses.chn: （用以加强语气）确实，无可置疑，真正地

ex.en: That was a disaster if ever there was one!
ex.cn: 那确实是场灾难！

senses.def: used to emphasize sth you are talking about
senses.chn: 确实如此；千真万确；一点儿不差

ex.en: 'You must have been upset by that.' 'Was I ever!'
ex.cn: “你一定曾为那事而心烦了。” “可不是嘛！”

senses.def: sometimes used at the end of an informal letter, before you write your name
senses.chn: （有时用于非正式书信末尾署名前）你的永远的朋友

senses.def: a tree or bush that has green leaves all through the year
continuing for ever; never changing
senses.chn: 永久的；永恒的；经久不变的

ex.en: everlasting life/love
ex.cn: 永生；永恒的爱

ex.en: an everlasting memory of her smile
ex.cn: 她的微笑留下的永久回忆

ex.en: To his everlasting credit, he never told anyone what I'd done.
ex.cn: 值得永远称赞的是他从未把我做的事告诉过任何人。

senses.def: continuing too long; repeated too often
senses.chn: 冗长的；持续过长的；重复太多的

ex.en: I'm tired of your everlasting complaints.
ex.cn: 我讨厌你没完没了的抱怨。

senses.def: always
used with singular nouns to refer to all the members of a group of things or people
senses.chn: （与单数名词连用，指整体中的）每一个，每个

ex.en: She knows every student in the school.
ex.cn: 她认识学校里的每一个学生。

ex.en: I could hear every word they said.
ex.cn: 他们说的每句话我都能听见。

ex.en: We enjoyed every minute of our stay.
ex.cn: 我们逗留期间每一分钟都过得很愉快。

ex.en: Every day seemed the same to him.
ex.cn: 对他来说似乎天天都一样。

ex.en: Every single time he calls, I'm out.
ex.cn: 他每次打电话来我都不在家。

ex.en: I read every last article in the newspaper (= all of them).
ex.cn: 报纸上的每一篇文章我都读。

senses.def: all possible
senses.chn: 所有可能的；完全可能的

ex.en: We wish you every success.
ex.cn: 我们祝你万事如意。

ex.en: He had every reason to be angry.
ex.cn: 他完全有理由感到愤怒。

senses.def: used to say how often sth happens or is done
senses.chn: （表示发生的频率）每，每逢，每隔

ex.en: The buses go every 10 minutes.
ex.cn: 公共汽车每隔 10 分钟发一班车。

ex.en: We had to stop every few miles.
ex.cn: 我们每走几英里就得停一停。

ex.en: One in every three marriages ends in divorce.
ex.cn: 三分之一的婚姻都以离婚告终。

ex.en: He has every third day off (= he works for two days, then has one day off, then works for two days and so on).
ex.cn: 他每隔两天休息一天。

ex.en: We see each other every now and again.
ex.cn: 我们偶尔相见。

ex.en: Every now and then he regretted his decision.
ex.cn: 他有时为自己的决定后悔。

senses.def: each alternate one (= the first, third, fifth, etc. one, but not the second, fourth, sixth, etc.)

ex.en: They visit us every other week.
ex.cn: 他们隔周来看我们一次。

every cloud has a silver lining.lemma: every cloud has a silver lining

senses.def: every sad or difficult situation has a positive side
senses.chn: 黑暗中总有一线光明；朵朵乌云衬银边，处处黑暗透光明

senses.def: used or happening every day or regularly; ordinary
senses.chn: 每天的；每日发生的；日常的

ex.en: everyday objects
ex.cn: 日常物品

ex.en: The Internet has become part of everyday life.
ex.cn: 互联网已成为日常生活的一部分。

ex.en: a small dictionary for everyday use
ex.cn: 常用小词典

senses.def: the whole of sth

ex.en: The doctor examined every inch of his body.
ex.cn: 医生检查了他全身的每一部分。

ex.en: If they try to fire me I'll fight them every inch of the way.
ex.cn: 他们要是想解雇我，我就和他们抗争到底。

senses.def: completely

ex.en: In his first game the young player already looked every inch a winner.
ex.cn: 那位年轻的选手在第一局比赛看上去就已经胜券在握了。

senses.def: an ordinary or typical person

ex.en: a story of Everyman
ex.cn: 寻常百姓的故事

senses.def: people must take care of themselves and not give or expect any help

ex.en: In business, it's every man for himself.
ex.cn: 生意场上都是人各为己。

senses.def: every part of a place; every aspect of a situation
every person; all people

ex.en: Everyone cheered and clapped.
ex.cn: 人人都鼓掌欢呼。

ex.en: Everyone has a chance to win.
ex.cn: 每个人都有机会赢。

ex.en: Everyone brought their partner to the party.
ex.cn: 所有人都携伴参加聚会。

ex.en: Everyone brought his or her partner to the party.
ex.cn: 每个人都携伴参加聚会。

ex.en: The police questioned everyone in the room.
ex.cn: 警方盘问了房间里的每一个人。

ex.en: The teacher commented on everyone's work.
ex.cn: 老师对每个人的作业都给了评语。

senses.def: you can persuade anyone to do sth by giving them more money or sth that they want
senses.chn: 重赏之下，必有勇夫；人皆有价；有钱能使鬼推磨

senses.def: each alternate one (= the first, third, fifth, etc. one, but not the second, fourth, sixth, etc.)

ex.en: They visit us every other week.
ex.cn: 他们隔周来看我们一次。

senses.def: all of the money

ex.en: We collected £700 and every penny went to charity.
ex.cn: 我们募集了 700 英镑，悉数捐给了慈善机构。

senses.def: occasionally; sometimes
all things

ex.en: Everything had gone.
ex.cn: 一切都过去了。

ex.en: When we confronted him, he denied everything.
ex.cn: 我们与他当面对质时，他什么都不承认。

ex.en: Take this bag, and leave everything else to me.
ex.cn: 把这个包拿走，其他所有东西都给我留下。

ex.en: She seemed to have everything —looks, money, intelligence.
ex.cn: 她似乎什么都有了——美貌、金钱和智慧。

senses.def: the situation now; life generally

ex.en: Everything in the capital is now quiet.
ex.cn: 目前首都的形势很平静。

ex.en: 'How's everything with you?' 'Fine, thanks.'
ex.cn: “你一切都好吗？” “很好，谢谢。”

senses.def: the most important thing
senses.chn: 最重要的东西；最要紧的事情

ex.en: Money isn't everything.
ex.cn: 金钱不是最重要的。

ex.en: My family means everything to me.
ex.cn: 对我来说家庭意味着一切。

senses.def: and so on; and other similar things

ex.en: Have you got his name and address and everything?
ex.cn: 你知道他的名字、地址及其他情况吗？

ex.en: She told me about the baby and everything.
ex.cn: 她向我讲了小宝宝和其他的情况。

senses.def: a very large number of things, probably more than is necessary
senses.chn: 过多的东西；大量的东西

everything in the garden is rosy.lemma: everything in the garden is rosy

senses.def: everything is fine
whenever there is a choice

ex.en: I don't really like cities—give me the countryside every time.
ex.cn: 我真不太喜欢城市，一有机会就让我去乡村吧。

senses.def: every available method, whether it is honest or not
senses.chn: 无所不用其极；浑身解数

ex.en: He'll try every trick in the book to stop you from winning.
ex.cn: 他将使尽浑身解数阻止你取胜。

senses.def: in, to or at every place; all places
senses.chn: 处处；到处；各个地方；所有地方

ex.en: I've looked everywhere.
ex.cn: 我各处都看过了。

ex.en: He follows me everywhere.
ex.cn: 我无论去哪儿他都跟着我。

ex.en: We'll have to eat here— everywhere else is full.
ex.cn: 我们只好在这儿吃饭了，其他地方都客满。

ex.en: Everywhere we went was full of tourists.
ex.cn: 我们所到之处游客人头攒动。

senses.def: in all directions

ex.en: Her hair tumbled every which way.
ex.cn: 她的头发乱得像鸡窝。

senses.def: physical contact, comments about sex, etc. by a man to a woman in a public place, that the woman finds annoying and offensive
senses.chn: （男性在公共场所对女性）性骚扰，性挑逗

senses.def: to force sb to leave a house or land, especially when you have the legal right to do so
senses.chn: （尤指依法从房屋或土地上）驱逐，赶出，逐出

ex.en: A number of tenants have been evicted for not paying the rent.
ex.cn: 一些房客因没付房租被赶了出来。

senses.def: the facts, signs or objects that make you believe that sth is true

ex.en: There is convincing evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.
ex.cn: 有可靠证据表明日光暴晒与皮肤癌之间有联系。

ex.en: The room bore evidence of a struggle.
ex.cn: 房间里有搏斗过的痕迹。

ex.en: We found further scientific evidence for this theory.

ex.en: This dictionary has many examples of how words are used.
ex.cn: 这部词典有许多关于词语用法的示例。

ex.en: Just to give you an example of his generosity—he gave me his old car and wouldn't take any money for it.
ex.cn: 且给你举个例子来说明他的慷慨吧——他把他的旧汽车给了我，而且分文不取。

ex.cn: 重要的是引用实例来证明你的论点。

ex.cn: 这个网站有各种各样的互动练习（比如：配对游戏、纵横填字游戏和智力测试）。

senses.def: a thing that is typical of or represents a particular group or set

ex.en: This is a good example of the artist's early work.
ex.cn: 这是这位艺术家早期作品的范例。

ex.en: It is a perfect example of a medieval castle.
ex.cn: 这是最典型的中世纪城堡。

ex.en: Japan is often quoted as the prime example of a modern industrial nation.
ex.cn: 人们经常举例把日本作为现代工业国家的典范。

ex.en: It is a classic example of how not to design a new city centre.
ex.cn: 这对于如何设计新市中心是个绝佳的反面教材。

ex.en: Can you give me an example of what you mean?
ex.cn: 你能给我举个实例来解释你的意思吗？

ex.en: In some cases people have had to wait several weeks for an appointment.
ex.cn: 在某些情况下，人们必须等上好几周才能得到约见。

senses.def: a person or their behaviour that is thought to be a good model for others to copy

ex.en: Her courage is an example to us all.
ex.cn: 她的勇气是我们大家的榜样。

ex.en: He sets an example to the other students.
ex.cn: 他为其他同学树立了榜样。

ex.en: She is a shining example of what people with disabilities can achieve.
ex.cn: 她为残疾人有所作为树立了光辉的榜样。

ex.en: He is a captain who leads by example.
ex.cn: 他是个以身作则的队长。

senses.def: a person's behaviour, either good or bad, that other people copy

ex.en: It would be a mistake to follow his example.
ex.cn: 仿效他的做法是错误的。

senses.def: used to emphasize sth that explains or supports what you are saying; used to give an example of what you are saying

ex.en: There is a similar word in many languages, for example in French and Italian.
ex.cn: 在许多语言，譬如法语和意大利语中都有相似的词。

ex.en: The report is incomplete; it does not include sales in France, for example.
ex.cn: 这份报告不完整，例如在法国的销售情况就没包括进去。

ex.cn: 将计算机科学与其他学科，如物理学，结合起来是可能的。

ex.en: The website has a variety of interactive exercises, including matching games, crosswords and quizzes.

ex.en: Web 2.0 technologies, such as wikis, blogs and social networking sites, have changed the way that people use the Internet. *
ex.cn: Web 2.0 技术，比如维基、博客及社交网站，改变了人们使用互联网的方式。

senses.def: to punish sb as a warning to others not to do the same thing
senses.chn: 惩罚某人以儆戒他人；用某人来杀一儆百

example.en: Her courage is an example to us all.
example.cn: 她的勇气是我们大家的榜样。

senses.def: to annoy or irritate sb very much
extremely annoyed, especially if you cannot do anything to improve the situation

ex.en: 'Why won't you answer me?' he asked in an exasperated voice.
ex.cn: “你为什么不愿意回答我？” 他愤怒地问道。

ex.en: She was becoming exasperated with all the questions they were asking.
ex.cn: 她开始对他们问的所有问题感到恼火。

senses.def: extremely annoying
senses.chn: 使人恼怒的；惹人生气的

senses.def: speaking with the authority of your position
senses.chn: 以职位的权威发言的；权威性地

ex.en: The Pope was speaking ex cathedra.
ex.cn: 教皇以宗座权威发表讲话。

senses.def: to dig in the ground to look for old buildings or objects that have been buried for a long time; to find sth by digging in this way
senses.chn: 发掘，挖出（古建筑或古物）

ex.en: The site has been excavated by archaeologists.
ex.cn: 这个遗址已被考古学家发掘出来。

ex.en: pottery and weapons excavated from the burial site
ex.cn: 从墓地挖掘出的陶器和兵器

senses.def: to make a hole, etc. in the ground by digging
senses.chn: 挖掘，开凿，挖空（洞、隧道等）

ex.en: The body was discovered when builders excavated the area.
ex.cn: 建筑工人挖地时发现了这具尸体。

example.en: The site has been excavated by archaeologists.
example.cn: 这个遗址已被考古学家发掘出来。

example.en: pottery and weapons excavated from the burial site
example.cn: 从墓地挖掘出的陶器和兵器

senses.def: the activity of digging in the ground to look for old buildings or objects that have been buried for a long time
senses.chn: （对古建筑或古物的）发掘，挖掘

senses.def: a place where people are digging to look for old buildings or objects

ex.en: The excavations are open to the public.
ex.cn: 发掘现场对公众开放。

senses.def: the act of digging, especially with a machine
a large machine that is used for digging and moving earth
a person who digs in the ground to look for old buildings and objects
to be greater than a particular number or amount

ex.en: The price will not exceed £100.
ex.cn: 价格不会超过 100 英镑。

ex.en: His achievements have exceeded expectations.
ex.cn: 他的成就出乎预料。

senses.def: to do more than the law or an order, etc. allows you to do
senses.chn: 超越（法律、命令等）的限制

ex.en: She was exceeding the speed limit (= driving faster than is allowed).
ex.cn: 当时她超速驾驶。

ex.en: The officers had exceeded their authority.
ex.cn: 这些官员超越了他们的权限。

senses.def: extremely; very; very much
to be very good at doing sth

ex.en: She has always excelled in foreign languages.
ex.cn: 她的外语从来都是出类拔萃。

ex.en: As a child he excelled at music and art.
ex.cn: 他小时候擅长音乐和美术。

ex.en: The team excels at turning defence into attack.
ex.cn: 这个队善于打防守反击。

senses.def: to do extremely well and even better than you usually do

ex.en: Rick's cooking was always good but this time he really excelled himself.
ex.cn: 里克的烹饪技术一直不错，但这次简直是好上加好。

example.en: She has always excelled in foreign languages.
example.cn: 她的外语从来都是出类拔萃。

example.en: The team excels at turning defence into attack.
example.cn: 这个队善于打防守反击。

senses.def: the quality of being extremely good

ex.en: a reputation for academic excellence
ex.cn: 因学术上的杰出成就而获得的声誉

ex.en: The hospital is recognized as a centre of excellence in research and teaching.
ex.cn: 这所医院已被确认为成就卓著的教学和研究中心。

example.en: The hospital is recognized as a centre of excellence in research and teaching.
example.cn: 这所医院已被确认为成就卓著的教学和研究中心。

senses.def: a title used when talking to or about sb who has a very important official position, especially an ambassador
senses.chn: （对身居要职的人，尤其是大使的尊称）阁下

ex.en: Good evening, your Excellency.
ex.cn: 晚上好，阁下。

ex.en: their Excellencies the French and Spanish Ambassadors
ex.cn: 法国和西班牙大使阁下

senses.def: extremely good

ex.en: an excellent meal
ex.cn: 一顿美味佳肴

ex.en: excellent service
ex.cn: 优质服务

ex.en: At $300 the bike is excellent value.
ex.cn: 这辆自行车 300 美元太合算了。

ex.en: She speaks excellent French.
ex.cn: 她法语说得好极了。

ex.en: It was absolutely excellent.
ex.cn: 这简直太好了。

ex.en: The rooms are excellent value at $20 a night.
ex.cn: 这些房间一晚 20 美元太合算了。

senses.def: used to show that you are very pleased about sth or that you approve of sth
senses.chn: （用以表示愉快或赞同）好极了，妙极了

ex.en: You can all come? Excellent!
ex.cn: 你们都能来？太好了！

senses.def: used before you mention the only thing or person about which a statement is not true
senses.chn: （用于所言不包括的人或事物前）除…之外

ex.en: We work every day except Sunday.
ex.cn: 我们除星期天外每天都工作。

ex.en: They all came except Matt.
ex.cn: 除马特外他们都来了。

ex.en: I had nothing on except for my socks.
ex.cn: 我除了短袜什么都还没穿。

ex.en: What other sports do you like besides football?
ex.cn: 除足球外你还喜欢哪些运动？

ex.en: I like all sports except football.
ex.cn: 除足球外我喜欢所有的运动。

ex.en: What other sports do you like apart from football?
ex.cn: 除足球外你还喜欢哪些运动？

senses.def: used before you mention sth that makes a statement not completely true

ex.en: I didn't tell him anything except that I needed the money.
ex.cn: 我什么都没告诉他，只是说我需要钱。

ex.en: Our dresses were the same except mine was red.
ex.cn: 我们的连衣裙是一样的，只是我的那件是红色。

senses.def: to not include sb/sth

ex.en: The sanctions ban the sale of any products excepting medical supplies and food.
ex.cn: 国际制裁禁止销售医药用品和食物以外的任何产品。

ex.en: Tours are arranged all year round (January excepted).
ex.cn: 全年都提供观光旅游（一月份除外）。

ex.en: Children under five are excepted from the survey.
ex.cn: 五岁以下的儿童不在调查之列。

example.en: The sanctions ban the sale of any products excepting medical supplies and food.
example.cn: 国际制裁禁止销售医药用品和食物以外的任何产品。

example.en: Children under five are excepted from the survey.
example.cn: 五岁以下的儿童不在调查之列。

senses.def: a person or thing that is not included in a general statement
senses.chn: 一般情况以外的人（或事物）；例外

ex.en: Most of the buildings in the town are modern, but the church is an exception.
ex.cn: 城里大多是现代建筑，不过教堂是个例外。

ex.en: With very few exceptions, private schools get the best exam results.
ex.cn: 私立学校的考试成绩是最好的，很少有例外情况。

ex.en: Nobody had much money at the time and I was no exception.
ex.cn: 那时候谁都没有很多钱，我也不例外。

ex.en: She wrote all of the songs on the album except for the final track.
ex.cn: 除最后一首歌外，这张专辑中所有歌曲都是她写的。

ex.en: Apart from / aside from the final track, all of the songs on the album were written by her.
ex.cn: 除最后一首歌外，这张专辑中所有歌曲都是她写的。

ex.en: The songwriting— with a few minor exceptions —is of a very high quality.
ex.cn: 除了几首歌美中不足以外，歌曲创作质量非常高。

senses.def: a thing that does not follow a rule
senses.chn: 规则的例外；例外的事物

ex.en: Good writing is unfortunately the exception rather than the rule (= it is unusual).
ex.cn: 可惜优秀的文字作品真是可遇不可求。

ex.en: There are always a lot of exceptions to grammar rules.
ex.cn: 语法规则总是有很多例外。

senses.def: people say that sth is the exception that proves the rule when they are stating sth that seems to be different from the normal situation, but they mean that the normal situation remains true in general
senses.chn: 反证规律的例外；足以证明普遍性的例外

ex.en: Most electronics companies have not done well this year, but ours is the exception that proves the rule.
ex.cn: 今年多数电子公司都不景气，而我们公司却是普遍中的例外。

senses.def: to allow sb not to follow the usual rule on one occasion
senses.chn: 允许有例外；让…成为例外

ex.en: Children are not usually allowed in, but I'm prepared to make an exception in this case.
ex.cn: 儿童一般不允许入内，不过这次我可以破例。

senses.def: to object strongly to sth; to be angry about sth

ex.en: I take great exception to the fact that you told my wife before you told me.
ex.cn: 你还没告诉我就先对我妻子讲了，为此我非常生气。

ex.en: No one could possibly take exception to his comments.
ex.cn: 任何人都不可能对他的意见提出异议。

senses.def: except; not including

ex.en: All his novels are set in Italy with the exception of his last.
ex.cn: 他的小说除最后一部外全是以意大利为背景。

ex.en: She wrote all of the songs on the album except for the final track.
ex.cn: 除最后一首歌外，这张专辑中所有歌曲都是她写的。

ex.en: Apart from / aside from the final track, all of the songs on the album were written by her.
ex.cn: 除最后一首歌外，这张专辑中所有歌曲都是她写的。

ex.en: The songwriting— with a few minor exceptions —is of a very high quality.
ex.cn: 除了几首歌美中不足以外，歌曲创作质量非常高。

ex.en: With only one or two exceptions, the songwriting is of a very high quality.
ex.cn: 歌曲创作质量非常高，仅有一两首歌例外。

ex.en: The majority of the compositions are less than three minutes long, with the notable exception of the title track.
ex.cn: 大多数曲目的长度都不超过三分钟，只有与专辑同名的曲目是明显的例外。

senses.def: used to emphasize that the statement you are making is always true and everyone or everything is included

ex.en: All students without exception must take the English examination.
ex.cn: 所有学生都必须参加英语考试，无一例外。

senses.def: unusually good

ex.en: At the age of five he showed exceptional talent as a musician.
ex.cn: 他五岁时就表现出非凡的音乐才能。

ex.en: The quality of the recording is quite exceptional.
ex.cn: 录音质量相当不错。

senses.def: very unusual

ex.en: This deadline will be extended only in exceptional circumstances.
ex.cn: 只有在特殊情况下才会延长最后期限。

senses.def: used before an adjective or adverb to emphasize how strong or unusual the quality is
senses.chn: （用于形容词和副词之前表示强调）罕见，特别，非常

ex.en: The weather, even for January, was exceptionally cold.
ex.cn: 这种天气即使在一月份也算得上非常寒冷。

ex.en: I thought Bill played exceptionally well.
ex.cn: 我认为比尔的球打得特别好。

senses.def: only in unusual circumstances
senses.chn: 只有在特殊情况下；例外地

ex.en: Exceptionally, students may be accepted without formal qualifications.
ex.cn: 在特殊情况下，也可能接受无正式文凭的学生。

senses.def: a short piece of writing, music, film, etc. taken from a longer whole
senses.chn: 摘录；节选；（音乐、电影的）片段

example.en: The document was excerpted from an unidentified FBI file.
example.cn: 此文件摘自来源不明的联邦调查局档案。

senses.def: more than is necessary, reasonable or acceptable

ex.en: You can throw away any excess.
ex.cn: 凡多余的你都可以扔掉。

ex.en: Are you suffering from an excess of stress in your life?
ex.cn: 你生活中的压力太大吗？

ex.en: In an excess of enthusiasm I agreed to work late.
ex.cn: 我一时热情过度答应了加班。

ex.en: He started drinking to excess after losing his job.
ex.cn: 他失业后便开始酗酒了。

ex.en: The increase will not be in excess of (= more than) two per cent.
ex.cn: 增加幅度不会超过百分之二。

senses.def: an amount by which sth is larger than sth else

ex.en: We cover costs up to £600 and then you pay the excess.
ex.cn: 我们最多支付 600 英镑的费用，超出的部分由你支付。

senses.def: the part of an insurance claim that a person has to pay while the insurance company pays the rest

ex.en: There is an excess of £100 on each claim under this policy.
ex.cn: 本保险单每次索赔均有 100 英镑的免赔额。

senses.def: extreme behaviour that is unacceptable, illegal or immoral

ex.en: the worst excesses committed by the occupying army
ex.cn: 占领军犯下的残忍暴行

senses.def: in addition to an amount that is necessary, usual or legal
senses.chn: 超额的；额外的；附加的；过度的

ex.en: Excess food is stored as fat.
ex.cn: 多余的食物作为脂肪贮存起来。

ex.en: Driving with excess alcohol in the blood is a serious offence.
ex.cn: 血液里酒精含量过高时驾车是严重的违法行为。

example.en: Are you suffering from an excess of stress in your life?
example.cn: 你生活中的压力太大吗？

senses.def: bags, cases, etc. taken on to a plane that weigh more than the amount each passenger is allowed to carry without paying extra
greater than what seems reasonable or appropriate

ex.en: They complained about the excessive noise coming from the upstairs flat.
ex.cn: 他们抱怨楼上发出的噪音太大。

ex.en: The amounts she borrowed were not excessive.
ex.cn: 她借的数量没有超额。

ex.en: Excessive drinking can lead to stomach disorders.
ex.cn: 酗酒可能引起胃病。

senses.def: an act of giving sth to sb or doing sth for sb and receiving sth in return

ex.en: The exchange of prisoners took place this morning.
ex.cn: 今天早上交换了俘虏。

ex.en: We need to promote an open exchange of ideas and information.
ex.cn: 我们需要促进思想和信息的公开交流。

ex.en: an exchange of glances/insults
ex.cn: 互换眼色；相互侮辱

ex.en: an exchange of fire (= between enemy soldiers)
ex.cn: 交火

ex.en: I buy you lunch and you fix my computer. Is that a fair exchange?
ex.cn: 我请你吃午饭，你给我修计算机，这算是公平交易吧？

ex.en: Would you like my old TV in exchange for this camera?
ex.cn: 用我的旧电视机换这架照相机，你愿意吗？

senses.def: a conversation or an argument

ex.en: There was only time for a brief exchange.
ex.cn: 只有简短的交谈时间。

ex.en: The Prime Minister was involved in a heated exchange with Opposition MPs.
ex.cn: 首相参与了和反对党议员的激烈争论。

senses.def: the process of changing an amount of one currency (= the money used in one country) for an equal value of another

ex.en: currency exchange facilities
ex.cn: 货币兑换服务

ex.en: Where can I find the best exchange rate / rate of exchange?
ex.cn: 在什么地方才能获得最好的兑换价？

senses.def: an arrangement when two people or groups from different countries visit each other's homes or do each other's jobs for a short time
senses.chn: （不同国家人或团体之间的）交流，互访

ex.en: Our school does an exchange with a school in France.
ex.cn: 我们学校与法国的一所学校进行交流。

ex.en: Nick went on the French exchange.
ex.cn: 尼克到法国去作互访了。

ex.en: trade and cultural exchanges with China
ex.cn: 与中国的贸易和文化交流

senses.def: a building where business people met in the past to buy and sell a particular type of goods

ex.en: the old Corn Exchange
ex.cn: 古老的谷物交易所

senses.def: to give sth to sb and at the same time receive the same type of thing from them

ex.en: to exchange ideas/news/information
ex.cn: 交流思想；互通消息；交流信息

ex.en: Juliet and David exchanged glances (= they looked at each other).
ex.cn: 朱丽叶和戴维相互看了看对方。

ex.en: Everyone in the group exchanged email addresses.
ex.cn: 所有的组员都相互交换了电子邮件地址。

ex.en: I shook hands and exchanged a few words with the manager.
ex.cn: 我和经理握了握手，交谈了几句。

ex.en: The two men exchanged blows (= hit each other).
ex.cn: 两个男人相互殴打起来。

senses.def: to give or return sth that you have and get sth different or better instead

ex.en: If it doesn't fit, take it back and the store will exchange it.
ex.cn: 如果不合适就把它拿回来，商店将给你更换。

ex.en: You can exchange your currency for dollars in the hotel.
ex.cn: 你可在旅馆把你的钱兑换成美元。

senses.def: to sign a contract with the person that you are buying sth from, especially a house or land
senses.chn: （尤指房屋或土地买卖时）订立契约

senses.def: to have an argument with sb

ex.en: We've had words.
ex.cn: 我们吵过架。

ex.en: Words were exchanged.
ex.cn: 发生过争吵了。

example.en: to exchange ideas/news/information
example.cn: 交流思想；互通消息；交流信息

example.en: I shook hands and exchanged a few words with the manager.
example.cn: 我和经理握了握手，交谈了几句。

example.en: You can exchange your currency for dollars in the hotel.
example.cn: 你可在旅馆把你的钱兑换成美元。

senses.def: that can be exchanged
senses.chn: 可交换的；可交易的；可兑换的；可更换的

ex.en: These tokens are exchangeable for DVDs only.
ex.cn: 这些赠券只能换 DVD 盘。

senses.def: (in Britain) the government department that controls public money
the public or national supply of money

ex.en: This resulted in a considerable loss to the exchequer.
ex.cn: 这使国库遭受了重大损失。

senses.def: a government tax on some goods made, sold or used within a country

ex.en: new excise duties on low-alcohol drinks
ex.cn: 低酒精饮料新的消费税

ex.en: a sharp increase in vehicle excise
ex.cn: 机动车消费税的剧增

ex.en: an excise officer (= an official whose job is to collect excise1 )
ex.cn: 国内消费税务官

senses.def: to remove sth completely

ex.en: Certain passages were excised from the book.
ex.cn: 书中某些段落已删去。

senses.def: the act of removing sth completely from sth; the thing removed
likely to become easily excited

ex.en: a class of excitable ten-year-olds
ex.cn: 一群易兴奋的十岁儿童

senses.def: to make sb feel very pleased, interested or enthusiastic, especially about sth that is going to happen

ex.en: The prospect of a year in India greatly excited her.
ex.cn: 有望在印度待上一年使她激动万分。

senses.def: to make sb nervous or upset and unable to relax

ex.en: Try not to excite your baby too much before bedtime.
ex.cn: 睡觉前尽量别使宝宝太兴奋。

ex.en: Don't excite yourself (= keep calm).
ex.cn: 别激动。

senses.def: to make sb feel a particular emotion or react in a particular way

ex.en: to excite attention/criticism/curiosity
ex.cn: 引起注意／批评／好奇心

ex.en: The news has certainly excited comment (= made people talk about it).
ex.cn: 这消息已经使人们议论纷纷了。

ex.en: The European Parliament is not an institution which excites interest in voters.
ex.cn: 欧洲议会是个激不起选民兴趣的机构。

senses.def: to make sb feel sexual desire
to make a part of the body or part of a physical system more active
senses.chn: 使（身体部位或身体系统某部分）活动；刺激…的活动

example.en: Don't excite yourself (= keep calm).
example.cn: 别激动。

example.en: to excite attention/criticism/curiosity
example.cn: 引起注意／批评／好奇心

example.en: The European Parliament is not an institution which excites interest in voters.
example.cn: 欧洲议会是个激不起选民兴趣的机构。

senses.def: feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm

ex.en: The children were excited about opening their presents.
ex.cn: 孩子们兴奋不已，想打开礼物。

ex.en: I'm really excited at the prospect of working abroad.
ex.cn: 我对有希望到国外工作着实很激动。

ex.en: Don't get too excited by the sight of your name in print.
ex.cn: 不要一看到你的名字出现在出版物中就过分激动。

ex.en: He was very excited to be asked to play for Wales.
ex.cn: 入选威尔士队使他非常兴奋。

ex.en: The new restaurant is nothing to get excited about (= not particularly good).
ex.cn: 这家新餐馆没什么值得特别激动的地方。

ex.en: An excited crowd of people gathered around her.
ex.cn: 一群激动的人聚集在她周围。

senses.def: nervous or upset and unable to relax

ex.en: Some horses become excited when they're in traffic.
ex.cn: 有些马在车流中会受惊。

senses.def: feeling sexual desire

example.en: The children were excited about opening their presents.
example.cn: 孩子们兴奋不已，想打开礼物。

example.en: I'm really excited at the prospect of working abroad.
example.cn: 我对有希望到国外工作着实很激动。

example.en: Don't get too excited by the sight of your name in print.
example.cn: 不要一看到你的名字出现在出版物中就过分激动。

example.en: He was very excited to be asked to play for Wales.
example.cn: 入选威尔士队使他非常兴奋。

senses.def: the state of feeling excited

ex.en: The news caused great excitement among her friends.
ex.cn: 这消息使她的朋友们兴奋不已。

ex.en: to feel a surge/thrill/shiver of excitement
ex.cn: 感到一阵激动

ex.en: He was flushed with excitement at the thought.
ex.cn: 他想到这就激动得满脸通红。

ex.en: The dog leapt and wagged its tail in excitement.
ex.cn: 狗兴奋得摇着尾巴跳来跳去。

ex.en: In her excitement she dropped her glass.
ex.cn: 她一激动把杯子摔了。

senses.def: something that you find exciting

ex.en: The new job was not without its excitements.
ex.cn: 这个新工作并非枯燥无味。

senses.def: causing great interest or excitement
senses.chn: 令人激动的；使人兴奋的

ex.en: one of the most exciting developments in biology in recent years
ex.cn: 近年来生物学上最令人振奋的进展之一

ex.en: They waited and waited for something exciting to happen.
ex.cn: 他们等啊等啊，等待着激动人心的事情发生。

ex.en: an exciting prospect/possibility
ex.cn: 令人激动的前景／可能性

ex.en: an exciting story/discovery
ex.cn: 激动人心的故事／发现

ex.en: This is one of the most exciting developments in biology in recent years.
ex.cn: 这是近年来生物学上最令人振奋的进展之一。

ex.en: They watched dramatic pictures of the police raid on TV.
ex.cn: 他们在电视上看到了警察突击搜捕的激动人心的画面。

senses.def: to say sth suddenly and loudly, especially because of strong emotion or pain
senses.chn: （尤因强烈的情感或痛苦而）惊叫，呼喊

ex.en: She opened her eyes and exclaimed in delight at the scene.
ex.cn: 看到这情景，她瞪着眼睛，高兴得大叫起来。

ex.en: 'It isn't fair!', he exclaimed angrily.
ex.cn: “这不公平！” 他气愤地喊道。

ex.en: She exclaimed that it was useless.
ex.cn: 她大叫说这是无效的。

ex.en: I thought I heard someone calling.
ex.cn: 我仿佛听见有人在呼喊。

ex.en: She cried out for help.
ex.cn: 她大声呼救。

ex.en: I cried out his name.
ex.cn: 我大声呼唤他的名字。

example.en: 'It isn't fair!', he exclaimed angrily.
example.cn: “这不公平！” 他气愤地喊道。

example.en: She exclaimed that it was useless.
example.cn: 她大叫说这是无效的。

senses.def: a short sound, word or phrase spoken suddenly to express an emotion. Oh!, Look out! and Ow! are exclamations.

ex.en: He gave an exclamation of surprise.
ex.cn: 他发出一声惊叹。

senses.def: the mark ( ! ) that is written after an exclamation
expressing surprise or strong feelings
to deliberately not include sth in what you are doing or considering
senses.chn: 不包括；不放在考虑之列

ex.en: The cost of borrowing has been excluded from the inflation figures.
ex.cn: 通胀数字未包括借贷费用。

ex.en: Try excluding fat from your diet.
ex.cn: 平时用餐时试一试不吃含脂肪的食物。

ex.en: Buses run every hour, Sundays excluded.
ex.cn: 公共汽车每小时一班，星期天除外。

senses.def: to prevent sb/sth from entering a place or taking part in sth
senses.chn: 防止…进入；阻止…参加；把…排斥在外

ex.en: Women are still excluded from some London clubs.
ex.cn: 伦敦有些俱乐部仍然拒绝妇女参加。

ex.en: Concern is growing over the number of children excluded from school (= not allowed to attend because of bad behaviour).
ex.cn: 大批儿童遭学校开除，人们对此越来越表关注。

ex.en: She felt excluded by the other girls (= they did not let her join in what they were doing).
ex.cn: 她感到自己受到其他女孩子的排斥。

senses.def: to decide that sth is not possible
senses.chn: 排除（…的可能性）；认为…不可能

ex.en: We should not exclude the possibility of negotiation.
ex.cn: 我们不应该排除谈判的可能性。

ex.en: The police have excluded theft as a motive for the murder.
ex.cn: 警方已排除这起谋杀案中有偷窃的动机。

senses.def: not including

ex.en: Lunch costs £10 per person, excluding drinks.
ex.cn: 午餐每人 10 英镑，酒水除外。

ex.en: She wrote all of the songs on the album except for the final track.
ex.cn: 除最后一首歌外，这张专辑中所有歌曲都是她写的。

ex.en: Apart from / aside from the final track, all of the songs on the album were written by her.
ex.cn: 除最后一首歌外，这张专辑中所有歌曲都是她写的。

ex.en: The songwriting— with a few minor exceptions —is of a very high quality.
ex.cn: 除了几首歌美中不足以外，歌曲创作质量非常高。

ex.en: With only one or two exceptions, the songwriting is of a very high quality.
ex.cn: 歌曲创作质量非常高，仅有一两首歌例外。

ex.en: The majority of the compositions are less than three minutes long, with the notable exception of the title track.
ex.cn: 大多数曲目的长度都不超过三分钟，只有与专辑同名的曲目是明显的例外。

senses.def: the act of preventing sb/sth from entering a place or taking part in sth

ex.en: He was disappointed with his exclusion from the England squad.
ex.cn: 他对自己没有入选英格兰队感到失望。

ex.en: Exclusion of air creates a vacuum in the bottle.
ex.cn: 瓶子里的空气排除后就产生真空。

ex.en: Memories of the past filled her mind to the exclusion of all else.
ex.cn: 她满脑子全是对过去的回忆，其他事情都不想了。

senses.def: a person or thing that is not included in sth
senses.chn: 不包括在内的人（或事物）；被排除在外的人（或事物）

ex.en: Check the list of exclusions in the insurance policy.
ex.cn: 检查一下保险单上的除外责任清单。

senses.def: the act of deciding that sth is not possible

ex.en: the exclusion of robbery as a motive
ex.cn: 排除抢劫动机

senses.def: a situation in which a child is banned from attending school because of bad behaviour

ex.en: the exclusion of disruptive students from school
ex.cn: 把捣蛋的学生开除出学校

ex.en: Two exclusions from one school in the same week is unusual.
ex.cn: 一所学校在一周内就有两起开除学生的事是少有的。

senses.def: designed to prevent a particular person or group of people from taking part in sth or doing sth
an official order not to go to a particular place

ex.en: The judge placed an exclusion order on him, banning him from city centre shops.
ex.cn: 法官给他下了禁令，禁止他进入市中心的店铺。

senses.def: an area where people are not allowed to enter because it is dangerous or is used for secret activities
only to be used by one particular person or group; only given to one particular person or group
senses.chn: （个人或集体）专用的，专有的，独有的，独占的

ex.en: The hotel has exclusive access to the beach.
ex.cn: 这家旅馆有通向海滩的专用通道。

ex.en: exclusive rights to televise the World Cup
ex.cn: 世界杯赛的独家电视播放权

ex.en: His mother has told 'The Times' about his death in an exclusive interview (= not given to any other newspaper).
ex.cn: 他的母亲在接受《泰晤士报》的独家采访时谈到他的死亡。

senses.def: not very willing to allow new people to become members, especially if they are from a lower social class
senses.chn: 排外的；不愿接收（较低社会阶层）新成员的

ex.en: He belongs to an exclusive club.
ex.cn: 他参加的是一个不轻易吸收新会员的俱乐部。

senses.def: of a high quality and expensive and therefore not often bought or used by most people

ex.en: an exclusive hotel
ex.cn: 高级酒店

ex.en: exclusive designer clothes
ex.cn: 高档名牌服装

senses.def: not able to exist or be a true statement at the same time as sth else

ex.en: The two options are not mutually exclusive (= you can have them both).
ex.cn: 这两种选择并不相互排斥。

senses.def: not including sb/sth

ex.en: The price is for accommodation only, exclusive of meals.
ex.cn: 此价只包括住宿，饭费除外。

senses.def: an item of news or a story about famous people that is published in only one newspaper or magazine
senses.chn: 独家新闻；独家专文；独家报道

senses.def: the quality of being exclusive

ex.en: The resort still preserves a feeling of exclusivity.
ex.cn: 这个度假胜地仍然保持着特有的情调。

ex.en: a designer whose clothes have not lost their exclusiveness
ex.cn: 设计的服装不失独特风格的设计师

senses.def: to punish sb by officially stating that they can no longer be a member of a Christian Church, especially the Roman Catholic Church
to irritate a person's skin so that it starts to come off
to criticize sb/sth severely
solid waste matter that is passed from the body through the bowels

ex.en: the pollution of drinking water by untreated human excrement
ex.cn: 未经处理的人体排泄物对饮用水的污染

senses.def: an ugly lump that has grown on a part of an animal's body or on a plant

ex.en: The new office block is an excrescence (= it is very ugly).
ex.cn: 这座新办公楼很是煞风景。

senses.def: solid and liquid waste matter passed from the body

ex.en: human excreta
ex.cn: 人体排泄物

senses.def: to pass solid or liquid waste matter from the body
connected with getting rid of waste matter from the body

ex.en: the excretory organs
ex.cn: 排泄器官

senses.def: extremely painful or bad
senses.chn: 极痛苦的；极坏的；糟糕透顶的

ex.en: The pain in my back was excruciating.
ex.cn: 我的背疼痛难忍。

ex.en: She groaned at the memory, suffering all over again the excruciating embarrassment of those moments.
ex.cn: 她在回忆中呻吟，又一次饱尝那时所经历的极度困窘。

ex.en: Is your knee still painful?
ex.cn: 你的膝盖还疼吗？

ex.en: a series of painful injections
ex.cn: 一次又一次令人痛苦的注射

ex.en: a slow and painful death
ex.cn: 缓慢而痛苦的死亡

ex.en: a sore throat
ex.cn: 咽喉疼

senses.def: to prove or state officially that sb is not guilty of sth
senses.chn: 证明（或宣布）无罪；为（某人）开脱

senses.def: a short journey made for pleasure, especially one that has been organized for a group of people

ex.en: They've gone on an excursion to York.
ex.cn: 他们到约克旅游去了。

ex.en: a business trip
ex.cn: 出差

ex.en: a five-minute trip by taxi
ex.cn: 五分钟的出租车车程

ex.en: a long and difficult journey across the mountains
ex.cn: 漫长而艰难的翻山旅行

ex.en: a trip to New York
ex.cn: 去纽约的旅行

ex.en: a round-the-world trip
ex.cn: 环球旅行

senses.def: a short period of trying a new or different activity

ex.en: After a brief excursion into drama, he concentrated on his main interest, which was poetry.
ex.cn: 他短暂涉猎过戏剧之后便把全部精力投入到他的主要兴趣——诗歌中去了。

senses.def: that can be excused

ex.en: Doing it once was just about excusable—doing it twice was certainly not.
ex.cn: 这种事干一次还可以原谅，干两次就绝对不能了。

senses.def: a reason, either true or invented, that you give to explain or defend your behaviour

ex.en: Late again! What's your excuse this time?
ex.cn: 又迟到了！你这次有什么借口？

ex.en: There's no excuse for such behaviour.
ex.cn: 这种行为说不过去。

ex.en: His excuse for forgetting her birthday was that he had lost his diary.
ex.cn: 他辩解说因为日记本丢了才忘了她的生日。

ex.en: You don't have to make excuses for her (= try to think of reasons for her behaviour).
ex.cn: 你不必为她辩解了。

ex.en: It's late. I'm afraid I'll have to make my excuses (= say I'm sorry, give my reasons and leave).
ex.cn: 时间不早了。很抱歉，我得告辞了。

ex.en: He said no but he didn't give a reason.
ex.cn: 他说不行，但没有说明原因。

senses.def: a good reason that you give for doing sth that you want to do for other reasons

ex.en: It's just an excuse for a party.
ex.cn: 这只是聚会的一个借口。

ex.en: It gave me an excuse to take the car.
ex.cn: 这使我有理由开车去。

senses.def: a very bad example of sth

ex.en: Why get involved with that pathetic excuse for a human being?
ex.cn: 为什么要与那个讨厌的家伙混在一起？

senses.def: a note written by a parent or doctor to explain why a student cannot go to school or sb cannot go to work
senses.chn: 假条（家长或医生写明请假或给假理由）

senses.def: to forgive sb for sth that they have done, for example not being polite or making a small mistake

ex.en: Please excuse the mess.
ex.cn: 这里凌乱不堪，请见谅。

ex.en: You must excuse my father—he's not always that rude.
ex.cn: 你一定要原谅我父亲，他并不总是那样粗暴无礼。

ex.en: I hope you'll excuse me for being so late.
ex.cn: 我来得这么晚，希望你能原谅。

ex.en: You might be excused for thinking that Ben is in charge (= he is not, but it is an easy mistake to make).
ex.cn: 你误以为是本在负责，这是情有可原的。

ex.en: Excuse my interrupting you.
ex.cn: 对不起，打扰你一下。

senses.def: to make your or sb else's behaviour seem less offensive by finding reasons for it

ex.en: Nothing can excuse such rudeness.
ex.cn: 如此粗暴无礼不能原谅。

senses.def: to allow sb to leave; to say in a polite way that you are leaving
senses.chn: 准许…离开；请求准予离开；（离开前）请求原谅

ex.en: Now if you'll excuse me, I'm a very busy man.
ex.cn: 如果可以，我先行一步了。我很忙。

ex.en: She excused herself and left the meeting early.
ex.cn: 她说了声 “请原谅” 就提前离开了会场。

senses.def: to allow sb to not do sth that they should normally do

ex.en: She was excused from giving evidence because of her age.
ex.cn: 因年龄关系她获准不予作证。

senses.def: used to politely get sb's attention, especially sb you do not know
senses.chn: （引起尤其是陌生人的注意）劳驾，请原谅

ex.en: Excuse me, is this the way to the station?
ex.cn: 劳驾，这是去车站的路吗？

senses.def: used to politely ask sb to move so that you can get past them
senses.chn: （客气地请人让路）对不起，劳驾，借光

ex.en: Excuse me, could you let me through?
ex.cn: 对不起，能让我过去吗？

senses.def: used to say that you are sorry for interrupting sb or behaving in a slightly rude way
senses.chn: （因打扰别人或失礼表示歉意）对不起，请原谅

ex.en: Guy sneezed loudly. 'Excuse me,' he said.
ex.cn: 盖伊大声打了个喷嚏，然后说了声 “对不起”。

senses.def: used to disagree politely with sb
senses.chn: （婉转地表示不赞成）对不起，请原谅，很抱歉

ex.en: Excuse me, but I don't think that's true.
ex.cn: 很抱歉，我认为这不是真的。

senses.def: used to politely tell sb that you are going to leave or talk to sb else
senses.chn: （婉转地要求离开或要与另外的人讲话）对不起，请原谅，抱歉

ex.en: 'Excuse me for a moment,' she said and left the room.
ex.cn: 她说了声 “很抱歉，失陪一会儿” 就离开了房间。

senses.def: used to say sorry for pushing sb or doing sth wrong
senses.chn: （因挤着别人或做错了事表示歉意）对不起，请原谅，很抱歉

ex.en: Oh, excuse me. I didn't see you there.
ex.cn: 啊呀，对不起，我没看到你在那里。

senses.def: used when you did not hear what sb said and you want them to repeat it
senses.chn: （没听清楚，请对方再说一遍）对不起，请再说一遍

senses.def: used to say that you are sorry for swearing
senses.chn: 请原谅我说脏话了；不好意思，我骂人了

example.en: There's no excuse for such behaviour.
example.cn: 这种行为说不过去。

example.en: His excuse for forgetting her birthday was that he had lost his diary.
example.cn: 他辩解说因为日记本丢了才忘了她的生日。

example.en: It's just an excuse for a party.
example.cn: 这只是聚会的一个借口。

example.en: It gave me an excuse to take the car.
example.cn: 这使我有理由开车去。

example.en: Please excuse the mess.
example.cn: 这里凌乱不堪，请见谅。

example.en: You must excuse my father—he's not always that rude.
example.cn: 你一定要原谅我父亲，他并不总是那样粗暴无礼。

phrases.filled: excuse sb for sth/for doing sth

example.cn: 我来得这么晚，希望你能原谅。

senses.chn: （客气地请人让路）对不起，劳驾，借光

ex.cn: 对不起，能让我过去吗？

senses.chn: 消除，除去（不好的或痛苦的想法）

ex.cn: 她终于把这些不愉快的记忆从头脑中抹掉了。

producing heat

ex.cn: 色彩鲜艳的异国花卉／植物／鸟儿

the quality of being exciting and unusual that sth has because it is connected with foreign countries

ex.cn: 学生人数在迅速增加。

ex.cn: 孩子的词汇量通过阅读得到扩大。

ex.cn: 呼吸时胸部肌肉使胸廓扩大让空气吸入肺部。

ex.cn: 新体制扩大了家庭医生的作用。

ex.cn: 我们增开了两家商店以扩展业务。

ex.cn: 我把问题重复了一遍，等着她详细回答。

ex.cn: 请你把那一点详细说明一下好吗？

example.cn: 这个系统的内存为 1 千兆字节，可扩充到 4 千兆字节。

ex.cn: 平坦而辽阔的农田

ex.cn: 经济迅猛发展期

ex.cn: 尽管经济衰退，公司对进一步扩展仍充满信心。

ex.cn: 本书是去年举行的系列讲座的扩充。

ex.cn: 本预算对经济的发展最终会有促进作用。

ex.cn: 美国的经济扩张主义

ex.en: military/territorial expansionism
ex.cn: 军事／领土扩张主义

ex.cn: 她展开双臂以示欢迎。

ex.cn: 以辽阔蓝天为背景的风景

ex.cn: 我们需要考虑这个用语所包含的更广泛意义。

ex.cn: 这篇文章是以他惯常的洋洋洒洒的风格写成的。

ex.cn: 她显然悠闲自在，心情豁朗。

ex.cn: 在经济发展快速的 20 世纪 90 年代，有才华的大学毕业生可以发展很快。

ex.cn: 居住在巴黎的美国人

ex.cn: 我们预计这个月的食物价格会上涨。

ex.cn: 休想得到我的同情！

ex.en: That's not the sort of behaviour I expect of you!
ex.cn: 我不敢相信你竟有那样的行为！

ex.cn: 不要指望在几个月内就能学会一门外语。

ex.cn: 我回过头去，预计可能看到有人跟踪我。

ex.cn: 你在等客人吗？

ex.cn: 我们昨天一直在等他。

ex.cn: 我们一直盼望着他昨天到达。

ex.cn: 他仍处于康复期，所以不要对他期望过高。

ex.cn: 他们期望自己所有的孩子都大有作为。

ex.cn: 我希望立即给付工钱。

ex.cn: 她强烈要求立即作出解释。

ex.cn: “你今晚要出去吗？” “我想不会吧。”

ex.cn: 期待的人群中突然欢声雷动。

ex.cn: 我们满怀信心地期待着完全康复。

ex.cn: 普遍认为他会获胜。

ex.cn: 预计地产价格会上涨。

ex.cn: 我申请这个职位是希望多于期待。

ex.cn: 完全没想到她过得非常快活。

ex.cn: 她满怀希望地进入大学。

ex.cn: 有些父母对孩子的指望不切实际。

ex.cn: 遗憾的是新软件并不理想。

example.cn: 我们满怀信心地期待着完全康复。

example.cn: 普遍认为他会获胜。

ex.cn: 出席会议的人数比预期的多一倍。

ex.cn: 今年的预计收入

ex.cn: 采取了禁止所有人出城的简单应急办法，使疾病得到了控制。

ex.cn: 计划／带队／去北极探险

ex.cn: 斯科特考察队的五名成员成功到达南极。

ex.cn: 五分钟的出租车车程

ex.cn: 写的东西不要超过 200 字。

ex.en: He uses a lot of long words.
ex.cn: 他使用了很多长词。

ex.en: technical/legal/scientific terms
ex.cn: 专门／法律／科学用语

ex.en: 'Old man' is a slang term for 'father'. *
ex.cn: old man 为俚语，指父亲。

senses.def: a strong show of feeling when you are playing music, speaking, acting, etc.
senses.chn: （演奏乐曲、说话、表演等时流露的）感情，表情

ex.en: Try to put a little more expression into it!
ex.cn: 尽量注入更多的感情！

senses.def: a group of signs that represent an idea or a quantity
a style and movement in early 20th century art, theatre, cinema and music that tries to express people's feelings and emotions rather than showing events or objects in a realistic way
not showing feelings, thoughts, etc.

ex.en: an expressionless face/tone/voice
ex.cn: 呆板的面孔／声调／声音

senses.def: showing or able to show your thoughts and feelings
senses.chn: 富于表情的；有表现力的；意味深长的

ex.en: She has wonderfully expressive eyes.
ex.cn: 她有一双会说话的眼睛。

ex.en: the expressive power of his music
ex.cn: 他的音乐的表现力

senses.def: showing sth; existing as an expression of sth

ex.en: Every word and gesture is expressive of the artist's sincerity.
ex.cn: 这位艺术家的真诚从一言一行中表现出来。

senses.def: part of a road on which certain vehicles can travel faster because there is less traffic
a place in a shop/store where customers can pay without having to wait for a long time
senses.chn: （购物场所收银结账的）快速通道

ex.en: Customers with ten items or less can use the express lane.
ex.cn: 购买十件以内商品的顾客可使用快速购物通道。

senses.def: clearly; definitely

ex.en: She was expressly forbidden to touch my papers.
ex.cn: 已经明确禁止她动我的文件。

senses.def: for a special and deliberate purpose

ex.en: The rule was introduced expressly for this purpose.
ex.cn: 这项规则是为此特意设置的。

senses.def: (in the US) a wide road that allows traffic to travel fast through a city or other area where many people live
to officially take away private property from its owner for public use
to take sb's property and use it without permission
the act of forcing sb to leave a place; the act of expelling sb

ex.en: These events led to the expulsion of senior diplomats from the country.
ex.cn: 这些事件导致一些高级外交官被驱逐出境。

senses.def: the act of sending sb away from a school or an organization, so that they can no longer belong to it; the act of expelling sb

ex.en: The headteacher threatened the three girls with expulsion.
ex.cn: 校长以开除来威胁这三名女学生。

ex.en: The club faces expulsion from the football league.
ex.cn: 这家俱乐部面临被足协开除。

senses.def: the act of sending or driving a substance out of your body or a container
to remove or get rid of sth, such as a name, piece of information or a memory, from a book or list, or from your mind

ex.en: Details of his criminal activities were expunged from the file.
ex.cn: 他犯罪活动的详细情况已从档案中删去。

ex.en: What happened just before the accident was expunged from his memory.
ex.cn: 事故前一刻发生的事他都记不得了。

senses.def: to remove or leave out parts of a piece of writing or a conversation when printing or reporting it, because you think those parts could offend people
senses.chn: 删除…中的不当之处；略去…中的不雅之处

senses.def: extremely beautiful or carefully made

ex.en: exquisite craftsmanship
ex.cn: 精美的工艺

senses.def: strongly felt

ex.en: exquisite pain/pleasure
ex.cn: 剧烈的疼痛；极大的快乐

senses.def: delicate and sensitive

ex.en: The room was decorated in exquisite taste.
ex.cn: 这个房间的装饰情趣高雅。

ex.en: an exquisite sense of timing
ex.cn: 时间安排上恰到好处的感觉

senses.def: having previously been a member of the army, navy, etc.

ex.en: ex-service personnel
ex.cn: 退伍人员

senses.def: a person who used to be in the army, navy, etc.
a person who used to be in the army, navy, etc.
still in existence

ex.en: extant remains of the ancient wall
ex.cn: 尚存的古城墙遗迹

senses.def: spoken or done without any previous thought or preparation
senses.chn: 即席的；即兴的；无准备的

senses.def: to speak or perform without preparing or practising
to make sth longer or larger

ex.en: to extend a fence/road/house
ex.cn: 扩建护栏／公路／房子

ex.en: There are plans to extend the no-smoking area.
ex.cn: 现已有扩大无烟区的计划。

senses.def: to make sth last longer

ex.en: to extend a deadline/visa
ex.cn: 延长最后期限／签证

ex.en: The show has been extended for another six weeks.
ex.cn: 展览会又延长了六周。

ex.en: Careful maintenance can extend the life of your car.
ex.cn: 精心保养可延长汽车寿命。

senses.def: to make a business, an idea, an influence, etc. cover more areas or operate in more places

ex.en: The company plans to extend its operations into Europe.
ex.cn: 公司打算将业务扩展到欧洲。

ex.en: The school is extending the range of subjects taught.
ex.cn: 学校正在拓宽授课学科的范围。

senses.def: to relate to or include sb/sth

ex.en: The offer does not extend to employees' partners.
ex.cn: 这项优惠不包括雇员的伴侣。

ex.en: His willingness to help did not extend beyond making a few phone calls.
ex.cn: 他帮助的诚意只限于打几个电话罢了。

senses.def: to cover a particular area, distance or length of time
senses.chn: 涉及（范围）；延伸（距离）；延续（时间）

ex.en: Our land extends as far as the river.
ex.cn: 我们的土地一直延伸到河边。

ex.en: His writing career extended over a period of 40 years.
ex.cn: 他的写作生涯超过了 40 年。

senses.def: to make sth reach sth or stretch

ex.en: to extend a rope between two posts
ex.cn: 在两根柱子间拉根绳子

senses.def: to stretch part of your body, especially an arm or a leg, away from yourself
senses.chn: 伸展，舒展，展开（尤指手臂或腿）

ex.en: He extended his hand to (= offered to shake hands with) the new employee.
ex.cn: 他伸出手来与新雇员握手。

ex.en: to extend the hand of friendship to (= try to have good relations with) another country
ex.cn: 向另一个国家伸出友谊之手

senses.def: to offer or give sth to sb

ex.en: I'm sure you will join me in extending a very warm welcome to our visitors.
ex.cn: 我肯定你们会同我一起向来访者表示热烈的欢迎。

ex.en: to extend hospitality to overseas students
ex.cn: 殷勤款待外国留学生

ex.en: The bank refused to extend credit to them (= to lend them money).
ex.cn: 银行拒绝向他们提供信贷。

ex.en: to extend sb an invitation
ex.cn: 向某人发出邀请

senses.def: to make sb/sth use all their effort, abilities, supplies, etc.

ex.en: Jim didn't really have to extend himself in the exam.
ex.cn: 吉姆大可不必为这次考试那么拼命。

ex.en: Hospitals were already fully extended because of the epidemic.
ex.cn: 这场流行病已使各医院疲于奔命。

example.en: I'm sure you will join me in extending a very warm welcome to our visitors.
example.cn: 我肯定你们会同我一起向来访者表示热烈的欢迎。

example.en: to extend sb an invitation
example.cn: 向某人发出邀请

senses.def: that can be made longer, or made valid for a longer time
senses.chn: 可延长的；可延伸的；可延期的

ex.en: an extendable ladder
ex.cn: 伸缩梯

ex.en: The visa is for 14 days, extendable to one month.
ex.cn: 此签证有效期为 14 天，可延期到一个月。

senses.def: long or longer than usual or expected

ex.en: an extended lunch hour
ex.cn: 延长了的午餐时间

senses.def: a family group with a close relationship among the members that includes not only parents and children but also uncles, aunts, grandparents, etc.
senses.chn: 大家庭（几代同堂的家庭）

senses.def: the act of increasing the area of activity, group of people, etc. that is affected by sth

ex.en: the extension of new technology into developing countries
ex.cn: 新技术向发展中国家的传播

ex.en: a gradual extension of the powers of central government
ex.cn: 中央政府权力的逐渐扩大

ex.en: The bank plans various extensions to its credit facilities.
ex.cn: 银行计划多方面扩展信贷服务。

senses.def: a new room or rooms that are added to a house
a new part that is added to a building

ex.en: a planned two-storey extension to the hospital
ex.cn: 计划在医院增建一栋两层的楼

senses.def: an extra period of time allowed for sth
senses.chn: 延期；延长期；放宽的期限

ex.en: He's been granted an extension of the contract for another year.
ex.cn: 他的合同获得延期一年。

ex.en: a visa extension
ex.cn: 延长签证

ex.en: The pub had an extension (= was allowed to stay open longer) on Christmas Eve.
ex.cn: 这家酒吧已获准在圣诞前夕延长营业时间。

senses.def: an extra telephone line connected to a central telephone in a house or to a switchboard in a large building. In a large building, each extension usually has its own number.

ex.en: We have an extension in the bedroom.
ex.cn: 我们的卧室里有一个分机。

ex.en: What's your extension number?
ex.cn: 你的分机号码是多少？

ex.en: Can I have extension 4332 please?
ex.cn: 请接 4332 号分机。

senses.def: the act of making sth longer or larger; the thing that is made longer and larger
senses.chn: 延长；扩大；延长（或扩大）的事物

ex.en: The extension of the subway will take several months.
ex.cn: 扩建地铁需用几个月时间。

ex.en: extensions to the original railway track
ex.cn: 原有铁路线的若干延伸路线

ex.en: hair extensions (= pieces of artificial hair that are added to your hair to make it longer)
ex.cn: 接长的假发

senses.def: a part of a college or university that offers courses to students who are not studying full-time; a programme of study for these students
senses.chn: （为非全日制学生开设的）进修部，进修课

ex.en: La Salle Extension University
ex.cn: 拉萨尔大学进修部

ex.en: extension courses
ex.cn: 大学进修课程

senses.def: the set of three letters that are placed after a dot at the end of the name of a file and that show what type of file it is
taking the argument or situation one stage further

ex.en: The blame lies with the teachers and, by extension, with the Education Service.
ex.cn: 应受指责的是教师，再则就是教育机构。

senses.def: (in the US) a person who works for a state university in a country area, and whose job is to give advice to farmers, do research into farming, etc.
senses.chn: （美国州立大学乡村的）农业技术推广研究员

senses.def: an extra length of electric wire, used when the wire on an electrical device is not long enough
senses.chn: 接长线路，延长线（电器上的电线加长部分）

senses.def: covering a large area; great in amount

ex.en: The house has extensive grounds.
ex.cn: 这栋房子有宽敞的庭院。

ex.en: The fire caused extensive damage.
ex.cn: 火灾造成了巨大的损失。

ex.en: She suffered extensive injuries in the accident.
ex.cn: 她在事故中受了重伤。

ex.en: Extensive repair work is being carried out.
ex.cn: 大规模的修缮工作正在进行。

ex.en: an extensive range of wines
ex.cn: 各种各样的葡萄酒

senses.def: including or dealing with a wide range of information

ex.en: Extensive research has been done into this disease.
ex.cn: 对这种疾病已进行了广泛研究。

ex.en: His knowledge of music is extensive.
ex.cn: 他音乐知识很广博。

senses.def: a muscle that allows you to make part of your body straight or stretched out
how large, important, serious, etc. sth is

ex.en: It is difficult to assess the full extent of the damage.
ex.cn: 损失情况难以全面估计。

ex.en: She was exaggerating the true extent of the problem.
ex.cn: 她夸大了问题的严重性。

ex.en: I was amazed at the extent of his knowledge.
ex.cn: 他知识之渊博令我惊奇。

senses.def: the physical size of an area

ex.en: You can't see the full extent of the beach from here.
ex.cn: 从这儿不能看到海滩全貌。

senses.def: used to show how far sth is true or how great an effect it has

ex.en: To a certain extent, we are all responsible for this tragic situation.
ex.cn: 我们都在一定程度上对这悲惨的局面负有责任。

ex.en: He had changed to such an extent (= so much) that I no longer recognized him.
ex.cn: 他变得我简直认不出了。

ex.en: To some extent what she argues is true.
ex.cn: 她的论证在某种程度上是符合事实的。

ex.en: The pollution of the forest has seriously affected plant life and, to a lesser extent, wildlife.
ex.cn: 森林污染严重影响了植物的生存，其次也对野生动物造成了影响。

ex.en: To what extent is this true of all schools?
ex.cn: 这在多大程度上符合所有学校的实际情况？

ex.en: The book discusses the extent to which (= how much) family life has changed over the past 50 years.
ex.cn: 本书论述了近 50 年来家庭生活的变化程度。

senses.def: showing reasons why a wrong or illegal act, or a bad situation, should be judged less seriously or excused

ex.en: There were extenuating circumstances and the defendant did not receive a prison sentence.
ex.cn: 因为有可减轻罪行的情节，所以被告未被判刑。

senses.def: the outside of sth, especially a building
senses.chn: （尤指建筑物的）外部，外观，表面，外貌

ex.en: The exterior of the house needs painting.
ex.cn: 房子外墙需要油漆。

senses.def: the way that sb appears or behaves, especially when this is very different from their real feelings or character

ex.en: Beneath his confident exterior, he was desperately nervous.
ex.cn: 他表面上自信，内心极度紧张。

senses.def: on the outside of sth; done or happening outdoors
senses.chn: 外面的；外部的；外表的；户外的

ex.en: exterior walls/surfaces
ex.cn: 外墙；外层表面

ex.en: The filming of the exterior scenes was done on the moors.
ex.cn: 外景是在高沼地拍摄的。

senses.def: an angle formed between the side of a shape and the side next to it, when this side is made longer
to kill all the members of a group of people or animals
a person who works in an institution but does not live there, especially a doctor or other worker in a hospital
senses.chn: 不住机构内的工作人员；（尤指）非住院医生，非住院的医院员工

senses.def: connected with or located on the outside of sth/sb

ex.en: the external walls of the building
ex.cn: 建筑物的外墙

ex.en: The lotion is for external use only (= only for the skin and must not be swallowed).
ex.cn: 此洗剂仅限外用。

senses.def: happening or coming from outside a place, an organization, your particular situation, etc.

ex.en: A combination of internal and external factors caused the company to close down.
ex.cn: 内外因结合导致了公司的倒闭。

ex.en: external pressures on the economy
ex.cn: 外部因素对经济的压力

ex.en: Many external influences can affect your state of mind.
ex.cn: 许多外在因素都可能影响人的心情。

senses.def: coming from or arranged by sb from outside a school, a university or an organization
senses.chn: 来自（学校或机构）以外的；外来的

ex.en: external examiners/assessors
ex.cn: 校外主考人／评定人

ex.en: An external auditor will verify the accounts.
ex.cn: 外部审计员将核实这些账目。

senses.def: connected with foreign countries

ex.en: The government is committed to reducing the country's external debt.
ex.cn: 政府决心减少国家的外债。

ex.en: the Minister of State for External Affairs
ex.cn: 外交大臣

senses.def: the parts of the ear outside the eardrum
a consequence of an industrial or commercial activity which affects other people or things without this being reflected in market prices
senses.chn: 外部性，界外效应（工商业活动所产生的影响，但不通过市场价格反映）

ex.en: Pollution is a negative externality that imposes a cost—reduced happiness—on the victims.
ex.cn: 污染是一种负面外部效应，使部分人的幸福被牺牲而成为受害者。

senses.def: the fact of existing outside the person or thing that is aware of it

ex.en: man's externality to an indifferent natural world
ex.cn: 相对于冷漠自然界的人类外在性

senses.def: to show what you are thinking and feeling by what you say or do
senses.chn: （以言行）表达；使（思想、感情）表露出来

senses.def: the outer appearance of sth
no longer in existence
senses.chn: 不再存在的；已灭绝的；绝种的

ex.en: an extinct species
ex.cn: 已灭绝的物种

ex.en: to become extinct
ex.cn: 绝种

senses.def: no longer in existence in society
senses.chn: 绝迹的；消亡了的；废除了的

ex.en: Servants are now almost extinct in modern society.
ex.cn: 在现代社会里奴仆已近乎不复存在。

senses.def: no longer active
a situation in which a plant, an animal, a way of life, etc. stops existing
senses.chn: （植物、动物、生活方式等的）灭绝，绝种，消亡

ex.en: a tribe threatened with extinction/in danger of extinction
ex.cn: 面临消亡威胁／有消亡危险的部落

ex.en: The mountain gorilla is on the verge of extinction.
ex.cn: 山地大猩猩已濒临灭绝。

ex.en: We know of several mass extinctions in the earth's history.
ex.cn: 我们知道地球历史上出现过几次大规模的灭绝。

senses.def: to make a fire stop burning or a light stop shining

ex.en: Firefighters tried to extinguish the flames.
ex.cn: 消防队员奋力救火。

ex.en: All lights had been extinguished.
ex.cn: 所有灯光都熄灭了。

senses.def: to destroy sth

ex.en: News of the bombing extinguished all hope of peace.
ex.cn: 轰炸的消息使和平的希望全部破灭。

senses.def: to destroy or get rid of sth that is bad or not wanted
senses.chn: 消灭，根除，除掉（坏的或不需要的事物）

senses.def: to praise sb/sth very much

ex.en: Doctors often extol the virtues of eating less fat.
ex.cn: 医生常常宣扬少吃脂肪的好处。

ex.en: She was extolled as a genius.
ex.cn: 她被誉为天才。

example.en: Doctors often extol the virtues of eating less fat.
example.cn: 医生常常宣扬少吃脂肪的好处。

example.en: She was extolled as a genius.
example.cn: 她被誉为天才。

senses.def: to make sb give you sth by threatening them

ex.en: The gang extorted money from over 30 local businesses.
ex.cn: 这帮歹徒向当地 30 多家企业勒索过钱财。

senses.def: much too high

ex.en: They are offering loans at extortionate rates of interest.
ex.cn: 他们在放高利贷。

senses.def: more than is usual, expected, or than exists already
senses.chn: 额外的；分外的；外加的；附加的

ex.en: Breakfast is provided at no extra charge.
ex.cn: 供应早餐，不另收费。

ex.en: The conference is going to be a lot of extra work.
ex.cn: 这次会议将有很多额外工作。

ex.en: an extra pint of milk
ex.cn: 外加的一品脱牛奶

ex.en: The government has promised an extra £1 billion for health care.
ex.cn: 政府承诺为医疗保健再拨款 10 亿英镑。

ex.en: Take extra care on the roads this evening.
ex.cn: 今晚在路上要格外小心。

senses.def: a thing that is added to sth that is not usual, standard or necessary and that costs more
senses.chn: 额外的事物；另外收费的事物

ex.en: The monthly fee is fixed and there are no hidden extras (= unexpected costs).
ex.cn: 月费是固定的，没有未言明的额外开支。

ex.en: Metallic paint is an optional extra (= a thing you can choose to have or not, but must pay more for if you have it).
ex.cn: 喷金属漆是自由选择的，要额外收费。

senses.def: a person who is employed to play a very small part in a film/movie, usually as a member of a crowd
senses.chn: （电影里的）临时演员，群众演员

senses.def: in addition; more than is usual, expected or exists already

ex.en: to charge/pay/cost extra
ex.cn: 另外收费；另付；额外花费

ex.en: I need to earn a bit extra this month.
ex.cn: 我这个月需要挣点外快。

ex.en: The rate for a room is £60, but breakfast is extra.
ex.cn: 一个房间收费 60 英镑，不含早餐。

senses.def: more than usually

ex.en: You need to be extra careful not to make any mistakes.
ex.cn: 你要格外小心，别犯错误。

ex.en: an extra large T-shirt
ex.cn: 一件特大号的 T 恤衫

ex.en: She tried extra hard.
ex.cn: 她特别努力。

senses.def: outside; beyond

ex.en: extramarital sex
ex.cn: 婚外性行为

ex.en: extraterrestrial beings
ex.cn: 外星人

senses.def: very; more than usual

ex.en: extra-thin
ex.cn: 特别瘦

ex.en: extra-special
ex.cn: 十分特别

senses.def: located or happening outside the body
a short passage from a book, piece of music, etc. that gives you an idea of what the whole thing is like

ex.en: The following extract is taken from her new novel.
ex.cn: 下面一段摘自她的新小说。

senses.def: a substance that has been obtained from sth else using a particular process

ex.en: yeast extract
ex.cn: 酵母萃

ex.en: face cream containing natural plant extracts
ex.cn: 含有天然植物提取物的面霜

ex.en: vanilla extract
ex.cn: 香草精

senses.def: to remove or obtain a substance from sth, for example by using an industrial or a chemical process

ex.en: a machine that extracts excess moisture from the air
ex.cn: 抽湿机

ex.en: to extract essential oils from plants
ex.cn: 从植物中提取香精油

senses.def: to obtain information, money, etc., often by taking it from sb who is unwilling to give it
senses.chn: 索取，设法得到（对方不愿提供的信息、钱财等）

ex.en: Journalists managed to extract all kinds of information about her private life.
ex.cn: 记者们终于得到了有关她私生活的各种信息。

ex.cn: 去剧院看戏是我们唯一的奢侈享受。

senses.def: something that is impressive or noticeable because it is unusual or extreme

senses.def: spending a lot more money or using a lot more of sth than you can afford or than is necessary

ex.cn: 我觉得花 100 英镑买一条连衣裙太奢侈了。

ex.cn: 她有很奢侈的嗜好。

ex.cn: 优质初榨橄榄油

ex.cn: 目前我们正在极大的压力下工作。

ex.cn: 沙漠中极其炎热。

senses.chn: 异乎寻常的；严重的；严厉的

ex.cn: 只有在极端情况下才会让孩子离开父母。

ex.cn: 千万不要做出诸如离开国家之类的极端行为。

ex.cn: 极端恶劣的天气状况

ex.cn: 极左／极右观点

ex.cn: 她坐在座位最边上。

ex.cn: 他以前很腼腆，现在却走向了另一个极端。

ex.cn: 严寒、狂风、暴雨

ex.cn: 极为重要／有用／复杂

ex.cn: 他终于摆脱了大部分公务。

a lively and confident person who enjoys being with other people

either of the two organs on the face that you see with

ex.cn: 嫌疑犯有着一头黑发和一双绿眼睛。

ex.cn: 我的眼睛里进了什么东西。

ex.cn: 蓝眼睛的金发女郎

ex.cn: 做外科医生眼要准，手要稳。

senses.def: a particular way of seeing sth

ex.cn: 他以工程师的眼光看这个设计。

ex.cn: 她以批判的眼光看待这些研究结果。

ex.cn: 他曾看到他毕生的劳动成果就在自己的眼前毁于一旦。

ex.en: We're up to our eyes in work.
ex.cn: 我们工作忙得不可开交。

senses.chn: 用眼光瞥（或扫）；匆匆查看；粗略地看一看

ex.cn: 你就粗略地看一下这报告可以吗？

ex.cn: 我几周没见到他们了。

ex.cn: 我希望永远不再见到这个地方！

senses.chn: 能进行准确判断（球的速度和方向）

ex.cn: 她善识便宜货。

ex.cn: 她一定会注意到那只破损的玻璃杯。这个女人的眼睛尖着呢！

ex.cn: 他讲话时大部分代表边听边悄悄看钟。

ex.cn: 他看中了你们班上新来的那个女孩。

ex.cn: 在她父亲看来，她不可能做坏事。

ex.cn: 我们已请邻居在我们外出时帮我们照看一下房子。

senses.def: to look for sb/sth while you are doing other things

ex.cn: 警方要求居民密切注意一切可疑的情况。

ex.cn: 我们注意寻找任何生命的迹象。

ex.cn: 你能问心无愧地看着我说你没撒谎吗？

ex.cn: 我再也不能坦然地面对她了！

ex.cn: “这是件文物。” “是文物才怪！”
