ex.cn: 他始终只爱自己的妻子。

senses.def: to think about or see sth the way that another person sees it

ex.en: Try looking at it through her eyes for a change.
ex.cn: 试试设身处地站在她的角度想想这事吧。

senses.def: to pretend that you have not noticed sth so that you do not have to deal with it
senses.chn: （对…）视而不见，熟视无睹，置若罔闻

senses.def: to stop giving your attention to what is most important
being watched carefully by sb
senses.chn: 在某人的密切注视下；在某人的监视下

ex.en: The children played under the watchful eye of their father.
ex.cn: 孩子们在父亲悉心看护下玩耍。

senses.def: if a person does not know about sth that they would normally disapprove of, then it cannot hurt them
senses.chn: 眼不见（心不烦）；眼不见为净

ex.en: What does it matter if I use his flat while he's away? What the eye doesn't see…!
ex.cn: 我趁他外出时用他的公寓有什么关系呢？反正他又看不见！

senses.def: with the hope of using a particular situation in order to gain some advantage for yourself
with the intention of doing sth

ex.en: He bought the warehouse with an eye to converting it into a hotel.
ex.cn: 他买这个仓库是为了将它改建成一家旅馆。

senses.def: fully aware of the possible problems or results of a particular course of action
senses.chn: 明知后果如何；明知有问题；心中有数

ex.en: I went into this with my eyes open so I guess I only have myself to blame.
ex.cn: 我是明明知道做这事的后果的，所以我想只能责怪我自己。

senses.def: having enough experience to be able to do sth easily

ex.en: I've made this trip so often, I could do it with my eyes shut.
ex.cn: 我经常走这条路，闭着眼睛都能找到。

senses.def: a person or thing that is loved more than any other
to open and close your eyes quickly, in a way that is supposed to be attractive
to show no surprise or embarrassment when sth unusual happens
senses.chn: 不动声色；面不改色；眼睛都不眨一下

ex.en: She didn't bat an eyelid when I told her my news.
ex.cn: 我把我最近的事告诉她时，她一点也不为所动。

senses.def: people all have different ideas about what is beautiful
senses.chn: 情人眼里出西施；对美的判别因人而异

senses.def: to be very surprised at sth you hear/see
senses.chn: 不相信自己的耳朵（或眼睛）；对所闻（或所见）非常吃惊

ex.en: I couldn't believe my eyes when she walked in.
ex.cn: 她走进来时我简直不相信自己的眼睛。

senses.def: a view of sth from a high position looking down
to pretend not to notice sth bad that is happening, so you do not have to do anything about it
senses.chn: （对某事）佯装不见，睁一只眼闭一只眼

senses.def: very quickly; in a short time
to attract sb's attention
senses.chn: 引起某人注意；惹人注目

ex.en: Can you catch the waiter's eye?
ex.cn: 你能引起服务员的注意吗？

senses.def: to watch sb/sth carefully

ex.en: Over the next few months we will keep a close eye on sales.
ex.cn: 在今后的几个月里我们将密切关注销售情况。

senses.def: to look at or listen to sth/sb carefully and with a lot of attention
to see sth by accident or not very clearly because you see it from the side of your eye and are not looking straight at it

ex.en: Out of the corner of her eye, she saw him coming closer.
ex.cn: 她用眼一瞟，见他正向她走过来。

senses.def: used to say that everyone was very emotional about sth
senses.chn: 全场无人不流泪；全场无不为之动容

ex.en: There wasn't a dry eye in the house when they announced their engagement.
ex.cn: 他们宣布订婚时大伙眼睛全湿了。

senses.def: pleasant to listen to or look at
senses.chn: 好听／好看的；悦耳／悦目的

senses.def: to the horizon (= where the sky meets the land or sea)

ex.en: The bleak moorland stretched on all sides as far as the eye could see.
ex.cn: 荒凉的旷野向四面伸展开去，一望无际。

senses.def: to look at sb/sth and get great pleasure
senses.chn: 尽情欣赏；大饱眼福；赏心悦目

senses.def: to be very obvious to sb
if you meet sb's eye(s), you look directly at them as they look at you; if two people's eyes meet, they look directly at each other

ex.en: She was afraid to meet my eye.
ex.cn: 她不敢正眼看我。

ex.en: Their eyes met across the crowded room.
ex.cn: 他们隔着拥挤的房间目光相遇了。

ex.en: She met his gaze without flinching.
ex.cn: 她毫不畏缩地与他对视。

senses.def: if a sight meets your eyes, you see it

ex.en: A terrible sight met their eyes.
ex.cn: 一幅可怕的景象映入他们的眼帘。

senses.def: a person or thing is more complicated or interesting than you might think at first
senses.chn: 某人（或物）比料想的更为复杂（或有趣）

senses.def: your imagination

ex.en: He pictured the scene in his mind's eye.
ex.cn: 他想象出了这一场面。

senses.def: the normal power of your eyes without the help of an instrument

ex.en: The planet should be visible with/to the naked eye.
ex.cn: 这颗行星肉眼应该就能看得见。

senses.def: to be quick to notice or hear things
to realize or make sb realize the truth about sth
senses.chn: （使人）长见识（或开眼界、认清事实）

ex.en: Travelling really opens your eyes to other cultures.
ex.cn: 旅游真正能使人开阔眼界，认识其他文化。

senses.def: to be very attractive to look at
well known to many people through newspapers and television
senses.chn: （通过报纸、电视）让公众熟知的，广为人知的

ex.en: She doesn't want her children growing up in the public eye.
ex.cn: 她不想让子女在众人瞩目中成长。

senses.def: to try to trick sb; to hide your real actions or intentions from sb
to always be looking for the chance to have a new sexual relationship
senses.chn: 总是找机会寻花问柳；眼神不安分

senses.def: a person or thing that you are pleased to see; something that is very pleasant to look at
very quickly
to watch sb/sth carefully in case you need to take action
senses.chn: 对…随时留意；对…小心提防

senses.def: to look at sb/sth carefully, especially because you want sth or you are suspicious of sth

ex.en: to eye sb suspiciously
ex.cn: 怀疑地注视着某人

ex.en: He couldn't help eyeing the cakes hungrily.
ex.cn: 他饥不可耐地盯着蛋糕。

ex.en: They eyed us with alarm.
ex.cn: 他们警觉地注视着我们。

senses.def: to look at sb in a way that shows you have a special interest in them, especially a sexual interest

phrases.pattern: the ~ of a/the storm, tornado, hurricane, etc.
phrases.filled: the eye of a/the storm, tornado, hurricane, etc.

senses.def: the whole of the eye, including the part inside the head that cannot be seen
very close to sb and looking at them, especially during an angry conversation, meeting, etc.
senses.chn: （与某人）面对面，怒目相视，对峙

ex.en: The protesters and police stood eyeball to eyeball.
ex.cn: 抗议者与警察剑拔弩张。

ex.en: an eyeball-to-eyeball confrontation
ex.cn: 面对面的对抗

senses.def: to have a lot of sth to deal with

ex.en: They're up to their eyeballs in work.
ex.cn: 他们的工作忙得不可开交。

senses.def: to have taken or been given a lot of drugs
to look at sb/sth in a way that is very direct and not always polite or friendly
a small container that you put a liquid in to wash your eye with
the line of hair above the eye
to have a lot of sth to deal with

ex.en: He's in it (= trouble) up to his eyebrows.
ex.cn: 他深陷于困境之中。

senses.def: to show that you disapprove of or are surprised by sth
senses.chn: 扬起眉毛（表示不赞同或惊讶）

ex.en: Eyebrows were raised when he arrived without his wife.
ex.cn: 他没有和妻子一起来，大家都很惊讶。

senses.def: a type of make-up in the form of a pencil, used for emphasizing or improving the shape of the eyebrows
a person or thing that is attractive but not intelligent or useful
senses.chn: 有魅力但不聪明的人；中看不中用的东西

senses.def: immediately noticeable because it is particularly interesting, bright or attractive
senses.chn: 惹人注意的；引人注目的

ex.en: an eye-catching advertisement
ex.cn: 醒目的广告

senses.def: an amount of sth such as liquid or dust that has been thrown, or blown into your eye
a person or thing that is beautiful or interesting to look at
senses.chn: 悦目的人（或物）；美人；好看的东西

senses.def: to look carefully at sth that is interesting or unusual
a lens for one eye used to help you see more clearly with that eye
one of the hairs growing on the edge of the eyelids

ex.en: false eyelashes
ex.cn: 假睫毛

ex.en: She just flutters her eyelashes and the men come running!
ex.cn: 她只要眨一下眼睫毛，男人们便忙不迭地跑过来！

senses.def: a hole with a metal ring around it in a piece of cloth or leather, normally used for passing a rope or string through
the height of a person's eyes

ex.en: Computer screens should be at eye level.
ex.cn: 计算机屏幕应该与眼睛齐平。

ex.en: an eye-level grill
ex.cn: 与眼睛齐平的铁栅栏

senses.def: either of the pieces of skin above and below the eye that cover it when you blink or close the eye

ex.en: She didn't bat an eyelid when I told her my news.
ex.cn: 我把我最近的事告诉她时，她一点也不为所动。

senses.def: the direction that sb is looking in
a type of make-up, usually black, that is put around the edge of the eyes to make them more noticeable and attractive
an event, experience, etc. that is surprising and shows you sth that you did not already know
senses.chn: 使人大开眼界的事情（或经历等）

ex.en: Travelling around India was a real eye-opener for me.
ex.cn: 周游印度真让我开了眼界。

senses.def: a piece of material worn over one eye, usually because the eye is damaged
senses.chn: 眼罩（通常因眼睛受伤而戴）

senses.def: the piece of glass (= a lens ) at the end of a telescope or microscope that you look through
so exciting, large or impressive that it is very surprising or difficult to believe; amazing
senses.chn: 令人瞠目的；令人大为惊奇的；令人惊叹的

ex.en: The special effects in the film were truly eye-popping.
ex.cn: 影片的特效实在令人叹为观止。

senses.def: the action of rolling your eyes, usually because you are annoyed or you do not believe or approve of sth
senses.chn: 翻白眼（通常因为恼火、不相信或不赞成）

ex.en: There's been a lot of eye-rolling in the office about the latest announcements.
ex.cn: 办公室里有很多人对最近的这些公告大翻白眼。

senses.def: causing sb to roll their eyes, usually because they are annoyed or they don't believe or approve of sth
senses.chn: 使人翻白眼的；令人不以为然的

ex.en: There were a few eye-rolling moments during the presentation.
ex.cn: 在演示过程中几度让人忍不住翻白眼。

senses.def: a type of coloured make-up that is put on the skin above the eyes (= the eyelids) to make them look more attractive
the ability to see

ex.en: to have good/bad/poor eyesight
ex.cn: 视力好／不好／差

ex.en: an eyesight test
ex.cn: 视力测试

senses.def: a building, an object, etc. that is unpleasant to look at
senses.chn: 碍眼的建筑；丑陋的东西；令人厌恶的东西

ex.en: That old factory is a real eyesore!
ex.cn: 那老工厂实在碍眼！

senses.def: a condition of the eyes caused, for example, by a long period of reading or looking at a computer screen
used when you are saying that you want sth very much

ex.en: I'd give my eye teeth to own a car like that.
ex.cn: 我巴不得有一辆那样的汽车。

senses.def: a thick ring of cloud around the eye of a hurricane (= calm area at the centre) of a hurricane
words, promises, etc. that are not true or sincere
so high or extreme that it is difficult or painful to think about it
senses.chn: （高得）难以想象的；令人心痛的；催人落泪的

ex.en: eye-watering fare increases
ex.cn: 超乎想象的交通票价飙升

senses.def: things worn on the eyes such as glasses or contact lenses
a person who has seen a crime, accident, etc. and can describe it afterwards

ex.en: an eyewitness account of the suffering of the refugees
ex.cn: 目击者对难民苦难遭遇的叙述

ex.en: Police have appealed for witnesses to the accident.
ex.cn: 警方呼吁这起事故的目击者出来作证。

ex.en: According to observers, the plane exploded shortly after take-off.
ex.cn: 据目击者说，飞机起飞后不久就爆炸了。

ex.en: A crowd of onlookers gathered at the scene of the crash.
ex.cn: 在撞车地点聚集了一大群围观者。

ex.en: Police asked passers-by if they had witnessed the accident.
ex.cn: 警察询问过路的人是否目击了这次事故。

ex.en: Three innocent bystanders were killed in the crossfire.
ex.cn: 三名无辜的旁观者在交火中丧生。

senses.def: a nest that is built high up among rocks by a bird of prey (= a bird that kills other creatures for food) such as an eagle
senses.chn: （在岩石高处筑的）猛禽巢，鹰巢

senses.def: a room or building in a high place, especially one that is difficult to reach and from which sb can see what is happening below
senses.chn: （尤指难以接近的）高处的房屋

senses.def: a magazine published in electronic form on the Internet
